newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa rise seen stalled at 1,080 stg.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa rise seen stalled at 1,080 stg.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa futures could rise further to extend a rally against an oversold background but the advance could be stalled at 1,080 stg basis second-month September, technical analysts said on Thursday.
Traders called the market to open unchanged.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analysis, said the current rally could extend to the first resistance at 1,080 stg.
The next hurdle was pegged at 1,090 but the real resistance was the top end of a chart gap of between 1,087 and 1,109.
"I suspect the rise will stall at the 1,080 region," she said.
The 14-day relative strength indicator of oversold/overbought conditions, stood at 44 percent and near the oversold territory of 30 percent.
Cocoa saw a big sell-off last week, pushing the September contract to 1,000 stg.
But broker GNI said despite Wednesday's bounce, the market was still vulnerable to downside movement.

"While New York is still technically within its uptrend, and London has bounced back over its recently breached uptrend, we believe that the specs that are still long will look to liquidate this rally rather than add to long positions," it said in a commentary.
It said fundamentally there had been some forward covering by the trade and light physical buying on the dip, but not the sort of activity one would associate with a big bull move, it added.
